description: The source reports annual physician headcounts by specialty for fee-for-service, Alternative Relationship Plan and blended payment arrangements under AHCIP. It excludes payments and services provided outside Alberta or Canada. Five XLSX descriptors compare adjacent fiscal years from 2009–2010 through 2014–2015, matching native coverage. This is healthcare workforce information by payment arrangement. It does not provide full-time-equivalent staffing or establish that practitioners in different arrangements can be summed without overlap. It remains separate from fee-for-service-only utilisation tables. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the original source identity and metadata. Source coverage is Alberta unless the described component explicitly includes Canada. The native licence field states Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs are unverified. No linked dataset, document, workbook, archive, installer, code or legal text was fetched. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown.
